label: Run a reversible probe
action: Spend 15 minutes making one specific offer, request, or tiny public artifact that another person can answer or use.
test: A reply, introduction, or use gives you information or a new next move.
why: Keep the cost capped while preserving the right to continue only after a signal.

label: Do useful maintenance
action: Tidy a list, rename files, or read without producing a decision point.
test: It may feel complete, but it rarely creates a new option.
why: Low downside alone is not enough.

label: Make a committed bet
action: Buy, promise, or build before testing the demand.
test: It may work, but the loss is hard to reverse.
why: Split it into a smaller probe first.

label: Avoid
action: Spend time or money on an irreversible task with no new information or access.
test: Even success leaves tomorrow largely unchanged.
